findings.statement: Official API scan (run 45623586499): 40 candidates seen, 38 qualified, 0 errors, 12 API calls, ~476 quota units, 25 outliers retained.
All 40 candidates had hidden subscriberCount; max_subs gate could not be verified and candidates were retained with subscriber_count_known=false.
Discover Inside “How Does an ATM Count & Dispense Money?” (NArAKj4zbB8): 39,560,300 views, 40 s, median of 10 surrounding uploads 2,830 => 13,978.76x outlier.
SagaLens “The Secret Behind Medieval Castle Windows” (06rlNjokJNA): 20,096,985 views, 26 s, median 10,918 => 1,840.72x; transcript uses an outside-vs-inside reversal hook.
MR.COLOGIST RBC counting video (sxN7z9UTqpM): 3,339,567 views, 62 s, median 2,503 => 1,334.22x; Hindi transcript explains Neubauer chamber method.
“Your fingers never really touch your phone” (BK2LymqGNPw): 7,808,085 views, 31 s, median 10,066 => 775.69x; fetched transcript is music-only, so hook evidence comes from the description only.
Kinesin animation (vwN2OTHZl3I): 344.46x but description declares significant editing and fair-use reuse; rejected by rights/reused-content gate.
Top raw ratio 20,254.10x belongs to a “Mechanical failure” fail-compilation (h1GBHgbGkAg); rejected as meme/reused-reaction content, not brand-safe original engineering.
ATM competitor is an AI/CGI “transparent ATM” animation; an original 3D cutaway with our own parametric rig is feasible and must not reuse its assets or shot-for-shot sequence.
Claws Vision still blocked: i.ytimg.com unreachable; no thumbnail palette/focal/text audit was performed.

gaps: subscriber_count hidden for every API candidate — channel-size gate unverified; use median_surrounding_views as scale proxy.
No comment mining and no visual thumbnail inspection.
API ratio is a relative signal, not proof of quality; winner still requires claim ledger + owner sign-off.
Do not copy the competitor CGI sequence; build original geometry, captions and sound.
